ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image there are five balloons, labeled respectively 3, 9, 13, 14, 18 points. The problem says Mia scored a total of 30 points. Enumerate the combinations that can make 30 according to these balloon point values: 18+9+3=30, 14+13+3=30. Checking other combinations, no other subset can equal 30.
